videos.caption: Your digital product checkout is more than a payment button. 👀 If you sell ebooks, templates, courses, guides, Canva templates, or other digital products, you need to think about what happens after someone clicks “buy.” Before selling your first digital product, make sure you have: 1️⃣ Purchase terms — what the customer is actually agreeing to when they buy. 2️⃣ License & use restrictions — what they can and cannot do with your product. 3️⃣ Privacy Policy — especially if you’re collecting customer information. 4️⃣ Website/store terms — the rules governing purchases and use of your store. 5️⃣ Protection against unauthorized sharing & reselling — because your digital product should not become the internet’s free download. 😭 Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. And remember: your legal protection shouldn’t start after someone steals or misuses your digital product. It should be part of your business from the beginning. Making 4-figures/month online is entirely possible. But it probably won’t come from creating an $8 digital product in Canva as a complete beginner. And it definitely isn’t as simple as the “AI passive income” side hustles flooding your feed either.  Think about it… If making thousands online were as easy as asking ChatGPT to help you create a digital product and selling it on social media, we’d all be doing it. 🤷🏽‍♀️ When I started digital marketing, I genuinely believed I’d hit 10K months within 90 days. Why?  Because when you’re desperate to change your financial situation, you will.  So I tried.  I grew an audience. Got millions of views. Spent month after month tweaking, fixing and trying to find the “ missing piece” And after 2 years, I made $40. 😳 The problem wasn’t that selling digital products doesn’t work.  It was being so focused on the tools, that learning how to actually market and sell the product wasn’t even on my radar.  You don’t know what you don’t know, right?  Here’s what what took me almost 2 years to learn 👇🏽 - Anyone can make a digital product. - Canva is a tool. - ChatGPT is a tool. - Social media and Etsy are platforms.  Tools and platforms don’t build online businesses.  ✅ Digital marketing skills do. Creating the product is the easy part. Learning why people stop, click, trust and buy? That’s what turns it into a business. ✨ Make sure to follow  if you want realistic beginner-friendly digital marketing education and tips so you can save time, money and energy.  #digitalproductsforbeginners #digitalskills #howtostartdigitalmarketing
